## 1. The map: her ten questions, and who answers each

| Her question | The words she reads | Answered by | Witness role |
|---|---|---|---|
| Q1 Jurisdiction, direct attack | BP 129 §33(3); PD 1529 §48 | ARP 00256; the 6 Feb 2026 order | None. Jonathan has identified the papers. |
| Q2 The authority, in writing | Art. 1874 "in writing"; Art. 1878 ¶5; Art. 1877 | Exh. E ¶7; Exh. B entry of 21 Jun 1996 | None. Patricia (rebuttal) only if they claim a power beyond the writing. |

The weight sits on Q3 and Q6. Q3 is carried by their witnesses in January. Q6 is carried by the King records, put to Princess and Jomil in January and offered on rebuttal. Our November witnesses carry Q6, Q8 and Q9 only, and lightly. That is why they are kept to one thing each.
